ideas.title: The Rise of 'Birth Tourism' in the United States
ideas.description: This story would investigate the phenomenon of 'birth tourism' and its implications for public health and immigration policy.
questions: What is the extent of 'birth tourism' in the United States?
How are hospitals and healthcare providers involved in this phenomenon?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a significant issue in the healthcare system and shed light on the complexities of immigration policy. By following the money and investigating the key players involved, we can uncover the truth behind 'birth tourism' and its implications for the United States.
